referents.why: 'me' in Pharaoh's speech: the speaker, Pharaoh.
referents.category: first person inside a quoted speech

referents.why: 'my people': Pharaoh's people, in Pharaoh's speech.
'he said': Pharaoh, the subject of the summoning and the speaking.
implied 'you' (2mp) of 'pray to the LORD': the composite Moses and Aaron, the ones summoned.
referents.category: implied plural subject of a command

referents.why: 'that he may remove': the one prayed to, the LORD (w12), named in cl2.
referents.category: third person inside a prayer to God

referents.why: 'I will let your people go': Pharaoh's own promise in his speech.
'that they may sacrifice': the people Moses and Aaron speak for, Pharaoh's 'your people' (w27).
referents.category: third person plural after a promise

links.why: wayyiqtol: he summoned them, then he said.
reversed and circular with cl0 then cl1.
'he said' introduces the commands of the prayer (R1).
'pray ... that he may remove': the jussive is the aim of the prayer, a purpose, not a plain and.
links.category: jussive of aim read as and

links.why: command (2mp) then jussive in a different person: the prayer is for the frogs to be removed.
plain waw from the jussive to Pharaoh's cohortative; a cohortative after a jussive is a promise, not a purpose.
the jussive after the promise states the purpose of letting the people go.
'I will let your people go, that they may sacrifice': the release is for the sacrifice.

groups.why: Pharaoh's speech to Moses and Aaron: the prayer, then his promise and its purpose.
the command to pray, with its aim (that the LORD remove the frogs); the aim's referent is the LORD.
the jussive that he may remove is an aim, and the cohortative after it is a promise; neither is a command.
groups.category: jussive or promise read as command

groups.why: the cohortative I will let go is a promise with a purpose, not a command; the purpose is a link.

cant_tell.what: whether 'then I will let your people go' is a result of the prayer being answered (an unstated condition) or a separate promise
cant_tell.why: the text does not say the release follows from the removal of the frogs, and no link type covers an unstated condition.
